raw_mentions: A U.S. individual may appear as Principal Investigator (PI), co-PI, or senior/key personnel on only one proposal per annual cycle submitted in response to this solicitation. For programs with no submission deadline, the 12-month cycle starts with the proposal submission date. For proposals submitted to NSF/CHE, the submission will count towards the total proposal submission limit to the Disciplinary Research Programs (DRP), as defined in NSF CHE-DRP and CHE-DRP:NDP solicitations. For German Personnel, there is no limitation.

Full Proposals: Full Proposals submitted via Research.gov: NSF Proposal and Award Policies and Procedures Guide (PAPPG) guidelines apply. The complete text of the PAPPG is available electronically on the NSF website at: https://www.nsf.gov/publications/pub_summ.jsp?ods_key=pappg .
